### Quantum Mechanics of the system

So I have the two charged particles trapped in an infinit potential well, that move along one axis. The particles interact by the Coulomb potential.

With $$T_1 = \frac{1}{2m_1}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x_1^2} \otimes \I$$ and $$T_2 = \I \otimes \frac{1}{2m_2}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x_2^2} $$ the hamiltonian of the system is given by

$$H = \underset{=H_{auto}}{\underbrace{T_1 + T_2 +V_{bound}}} + V_{int}$$

We introduce $H_{auto}$ as the hamiltonian of the two trapped particles without interaction. The eigenbasis of to this problem is known:

$$H_{auto}\,\ket{\varphi^{L}_n}\otimes \ket{\varphi^{R}_m} = (E_n+E_m) \ket{\varphi^{L}_n}\otimes \ket{\varphi^{R}_m}$$

The eigenbasis in position space is given by sinusoidal functions, $\varphi^{L}_n(x_1) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{L}}\sin(\frac{n\pi (x_1-L-\epsilon)}{L})$ and $\varphi^{R}_m(x_2) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{L+}}\sin(\frac{m\pi (x_2+\epsilon)}{L})$.
